translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
woh haqeeqat jo ho ker rahey gi !
kiya hai woh haqeeqat jo ho ker rahey gi-?
aur tumhen kiya pata kay woh haqeeqat kiya hai jo ho ker rahey gi-?
samood aur aad ki qoamon ney ussi jhanjorr daalney wali haqeeqat ko jhutlaya tha .
nateeja yeh kay jo samood kay log thay , woh ( chinghaarr ki ) aesi aafat say halak kiye gaye jo hadd say ziyada ( khofnak ) thi .
aur jo aad kay log thay , unhen aik aesi bey qaboo toofani huwa say halak kiya gaya

jissay Allah ney unn per saat raat aur aath din lagataar musallat rakha .   chunacheh tum ( agar wahan hotay to ) dekhtay kay woh log wahan khujoor kay khokhlay tanon ki tarah pacharay huye parray thay .
abb kiya unn mein say koi bacha huwa nazar aata hai-?
aur firon aur uss say pehlay kay logon  ney aur ( loat ( aleh-assalam ) ki ) ulti hoi bastiyon ney bhi issi jurm ka irtikab kiya tha ,
kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar kay payghumber ki nafarmani ki thi , iss liye Allah ney unhen sakht pakar mein ley liya .
jab paani tughyani per aaya to hum ney tumhen kashti mein sawar kerdiya ,
takay hum iss waqaey ko tumharay liye sabaq aamoz bana den aur yaad rakhney walay kaan issay ( sunn ker ) yaad rakhen .
phir jab aik hi dafa soor mein phoonk maar di jaye gi ,
aur zameen aur paharon ko utha ker aik hi zarab mein reza reza kerdiya jaye ga ,
tu uss din woh waqiaa paish aajaye ga jissay paish aana hai .
aur aasman phatt parray ga , aur woh uss din bilkul boda parr-jaye ga .
aur farishtay uss kay kinaron per hon gay , aur tumharay perwerdigar kay arsh ko uss din aath farishtay apney oopper uthaye huye hon gay .
uss din tumhari paishi issi tarah hogi kay tumhari koi chupi hoi cheez chupi nahi rahey gi .
phir jiss kissi ko uss ka aemal nama uss kay dayen haath mein diya jaye ga ,   woh kahey ga kay :  logo ! lo yeh mera aemal nama parho ,
mein pehlay hi samajhta tha kay mujhay apney hisab ka samna kerna hoga .
chunacheh woh mann pasand aesh mein hoga ,
uss oonchi jannat mein
jiss kay phal jhukay parr rahey hon gay ,
. ( kaha jaye ga kay : )  apney unn aemal kay silay mein mazay say khao piyo , jo tum ney guzray huye dino mein kiye thay .
raha woh shaks jiss ka aemal nama uss kay bayen haath mein diya jaye ga , to woh kahey ga kay :  aey kaash ! mujhay mera aemal nama diya hi naa jata ,
aur mujhay khabar bhi naa hoti kay mera hisab kiya hai ?
aey kaash ! kay meri moat hi per mera kaam tamam hojata !
mera maal meray kuch kaam naa aaya ,
mera sara zor mujh say jata raha .
. ( aesay shaks kay baaray mein hukum hoga : )  pakro issay , aur iss kay galay mein toq daal do ,
phir issay dozakh mein jhonk do ,
phir issay aesi zanjeer mein piro do jiss ki paymaish satar haath kay barabar ho .
yeh naa to khudaye buzurg o bartar per emaan lata tha ,
aur naa gharib ko khana khilaney ki targheeb deta tha ,
lehaza aaj yahan naa iss ka koi yaaro madadgaar hai ,
aur naa iss ko koi khaney ki cheez moyassar hai , siwaye ghisleen kay ,
jissay gunehgaaron kay siwa koi nahi khaye ga .
abb mein qasam khata hun uss ki bhi jissay tum dekhtay ho ,
aur uss ki bhi jissay tum nahi dekhtay
kay yeh ( Quran ) aik moaziz paygham laney walay ka kalam hai ,
aur yeh kissi shaeer ka kalam nahi hai . ( magar ) tum emaan thora hi latay ho ,
aur naa yeh kissi kahin ka kalam hai . ( magar ) tum sabaq thora hi letay ho .
yeh kalam tamam jahano kay perwerdigar ki taraf say utaara jaraha hai .
aur agar ( bil-farz ) yeh payghumber kuch ( jhooti ) baaten bana ker humari taraf mansoob ker-detay ,
tu hum inn ka dahana haath pakartay ,
phir hum inn ki sheh rag kaat detay
phir tum mein say koi naa hota jo unn kay bachao kay liye aarray aa-sakta .
aur yaqeen jano kay yeh perhezgaron kay liye aik naseehat hai ,
aur hamen khoob maloom hai kay tum mein kuch log jhutlaney walay bhi hain .
aur yeh ( Quran ) aesay kafiron kay liye hasrat ka sabab hai .
aur yehi woh yaqeeni baat hai jo sarasar haq hai .
lehaza tum apney perwerdigar kay azmat walay naam ki tasbeeh kertay raho .
